hypothesis.soft_tail_vs_hard_tail: HYPOTHESIS: Replacing F_FIX_25R_v2's hard drop of |score| > 1200 (v2 f_fix_summary.json: drop_tail_1200=17,872,184 out of 281,241,466 rows) with soft_tail_weights_u8 (0.25x = weight_u8=32 on |score| > 1200, 1.0x = weight_u8=128 otherwise) in weighted MSE preserves winning/losing endgame signal (including won_endings_syzygy_20k.fqs.z where 7,000/20,000 rows have |score16| > 1200, kept at 1.0x=128) while damping extreme-score gradient dominance.
hypothesis.wld_and_zero_thinning: HYPOTHESIS: Applying wld_filter_mask calibrated to Forge's eval_scale=400.0 (b_scale=1.5, per-round deterministic SplitMix64 seed = seed * 1000003 + round_idx) followed by thin_zero_runs_mask (max_consecutive_zeros=2 on WLD-surviving 1D rows) replaces rigid F-03/F-03b step thresholds and removes consecutive (score==0, res==0) draw runs.
hypothesis.d01_endgame_preservation: HYPOTHESIS: Composing D-01 deterministic Zobrist+SplitMix64 within-game decorrelation on pieces >= 6 (50% default keep, optional cross-round Uint64DedupStore) while keeping 100% of WLD+zero-surviving pieces <= 5 endgame rows reduces late-middlegame/opening correlation (Neon's count: 101.32 quiet rows/game, lag1_score_corr_quiet=0.99697) without diluting OB0 endgame representation.

ply_proxy_caveat.detail: pipeline/forge_parse.py:125-132 and pipeline/forge_train.py:93-95,124-131 discard ply from _parse_plain and .cache.npz. When 'ply' is absent in the input tensor dict, run_f_fix_v4_prod_p2.py uses the deterministic piece_proxy formula ((32 - pieces).clamp(0, 30) * 6).clamp(8, 240) where pieces = (codes != 0).sum(dim=1) (configurable via --ply-mode piece_proxy|constant and --default-ply 60). This is an approximation until .plain/.fqs loaders preserve true ply.

composition_order: 1. wld_filter_mask(score, res, ply_or_piece_proxy, seed=seed*1000003+round_idx, b_scale=1.5, eval_scale=400.0)
2. thin_zero_runs_mask(score_wld, res_wld, max_consecutive_zeros=2) on WLD-surviving 1D rows
3. D-01 Zobrist+SplitMix64 decorrelation on pieces >= 6 (1/2 default keep, optional cross-round dedup) with 100% keep on surviving pieces <= 5 rows
4. soft_tail_weights_u8(score_kept, tail_cp=1200, tail_weight_u8=32, normal_weight_u8=128) (no F-08 hard drop)

weighted_mse_path.loss_formula: (bw * (pred - target).pow(2)).sum() / bw.sum().clamp(min=1e-7) with bw = weight_u8[idx.long()].float(); val hold-out dict has no weight_u8 and remains unweighted
wrapped_entrypoints: compact_record.load_compact (single-pass, iso_cache_dir=None, allocates uint8 weight_u8 with .cpu() read-back check)
forge_train_v3.batch_loss_once (weighted MSE when teacher_p is not None)
